overviewLayoutSource: Live Forever C_Map.GetMapInfo, GetMapChildrenInfo and GetMapRectOnMap; no static TBC polygons
notes: Native Forever zone artwork uses native zone coordinates directly. Overview positions and navigation are projected using live parent-map rectangles. UiMap 2665 is a second Zephras Isle map whose artwork coordinate frame is unverified; it retains a native coordinate grid.
dungeonFloorPattern: https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/maps/enus/original/{areaId}-{floor}.jpg ({areaId}.jpg for Zul'Farrak, Zul'Gurub and Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj)
dungeonNotes: WoW Forever has no UiMap IDs for instance floors; app/dungeons.json gives each floor a companion-only ID (50000 + instance ID * 10 + floor). Floor order and names follow the Forever client's own floor art (the OpenMap addon's Data/Forever/DungeonMaps.lua, generated from the install). Every Wowhead floor image was checked against the client's floor tiles (correlation >= 0.999); 1009 x 673 exports are cropped to the 1002 x 668 map area. Player positions are not available inside instances.
